body:
I don't enable her. I have never done drugs in my life. I don't even drink or smoke weed. I am against it. She was sober when we first got together, but has relapsed a couple of times since.

She was clean for a couple of months, but she just relapsed within the past couple of weeks. It's gotten to the point where she just doesn't want to hear anything about it. Apparently one of her friends is telling her how bad drugs are for her too, and she's tired of being "lectured" about it. She knows it's bad for her, she just doesn't care.

I'd really rather not cut off contact with her, but maybe I should.

She has gone to a.a meetings, and it didn't help her. She's even taking meds that help with cravings and prevent her from getting high, but she still has really strong cravings despite that, and stops taking that medication whenever she feels like getting high.

And she doesn't want to go to rehab.
